_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see config/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults. Agent values are kept in the agent's model_backup overlay.

settings.description: How many times a model call that failed with a temporary provider error is retried on the same model before it switches to the next alias or stops.
examples: retry overloaded providers more times
give up sooner when a provider is down
settings.notes: The engine also stops a call after workflow.max_attempts dispatches (loop-runtime.json, 3), which counts the first try; more retries need that raised too.

settings.description: Wait before each same-model retry; the last value repeats for further retries.
examples: wait longer between retries
retry after 5 seconds first

settings.description: Random extra share added to each retry wait so many runs do not retry at the same moment.
examples: spread out retries more
no random retry delay

settings.description: Longest wait honored when a provider asks to retry later.
examples: honor provider retry hints up to two minutes

settings.description: How long a model may take to start answering before the call counts as failed (and is retried or switched to the next alias).
examples: allow slower first responses
fail faster when a provider does not answer
switch models sooner when one hangs

settings.description: Switch to the next alias after a temporary provider error once the same-model retries are used up.
examples: don't switch models on overload errors
fall back when a provider keeps timing out

settings.description: Switch to the next alias at once when the model's quota or credit is used up.
examples: switch models when I run out of credit
stop instead of switching on quota errors

settings.description: Switch to the next alias at once when the model's connection key is rejected.
examples: fall back when an API key is invalid

settings.description: Switch to the next alias at once when the provider says the model is unavailable, or when a bridge model has no paired client running. The session then stays on that alias until its context is next reordered (cache timeout or changed tools), which tries the first model again.
examples: switch when a model is retired or down

settings.description: After every alias has failed on a run that is safe to resume (a temporary provider error, or a bridge model whose paired client is offline), how long to wait before resuming it automatically.
examples: auto resume stopped runs after 5 minutes
resume sooner after an outage

settings.description: How many times a stopped run is resumed automatically before waiting for the user.
examples: never auto resume
auto resume twice

excluded./schema_version: File format version; not a setting.
excluded./retry_delays_seconds: A list; each wait is described on its own (chat.model_backup.retry_delays_seconds).
